answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 2654 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissable to watch the makkah taraweeh namaz on the internet or the t.v in the month of ramadhan and not in the month of ramadhan? Question: Is it permissable to watch the makkah taraweeh namaz on the internet or the t.v in the month of ramadhan and not in the month of ramadhan? Answer ID: 2654 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2/2=L) It is wrong to watch fair programmes also on television. Yes, one can see it using internet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
